text: Right. I just gave it skins. it is not rendering with them though. look [Image #7] vs [Image #8]
resolution: User applied brick skins but the compiled world still showed flat gray. Diagnosed: the skins are 'custom:' Materialized looks (custom:a-brick-v0 etc.) living in the editor's localstore.db, and (1) the bake only resolved built-in shaderSpec ids, and (2) the headless bake runtime v8cli had NO localstore binding, so loadCustomTextures returned 0. Fixed both: worldGeometry.resolveMaterialShader now resolves custom SHADER looks via loadCustomTextures (base shaderId WGSL + frozen tuned data), and a new light host module v8_bindings_localstore.zig wires __localstore* into v8cli over the same localstore.db the editor writes (tools/v8cli rebuilt). Verified end-to-end: bake finds 5 custom textures, ships 3 brick materials; loader decodes '3 face material(s) → 3 textured batch(es)' with no crash. The forced-default-data proof earlier already rendered the brick shader; couldn't frame the building in the headless auto-shot to re-confirm, so the user's navigable run is the visual check. Decal/react customs still fall back to flat color (no WGSL to ship).
